tool.name: team-status
tool.description:
Queries the caller's team status and returns a structured JSON summary: teamId, teamName, status, member list (memberName / role / sessionId / actorId / bound) and the team's task count.
**Parameters**: none. The caller's team is resolved from the session (no teamId parameter).
**Semantics**: - ACL: `view` action requires READ (LEAD/MEMBER allowed, non-members denied). - Honest fail-loud: if team functionality is not enabled (NoOp team manager) the tool reports the status was NOT returned — it never fabricates a team snapshot. A caller not bound to any team returns an explicit error.
